all_candidates.topic: Should social media platforms be liable for E20 deepfakes?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Bombay High Court allowed Nitin Gadkari to sue Meta and X over alleged E20 deepfakes (July 28, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should the anti-paper leak law apply to all exams?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre introduced a stringent anti-paper leak law, prescribing minimum five years imprisonment and fines up to Rs 50 lakh (July 27, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should the government intervene to lower current fuel prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government remained non-committal on reducing petrol and diesel prices despite crude oil fluctuations, citing international volatility (July 23, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is AI-driven workforce restructuring justified in India's tech sector?
all_candidates.news_anchor: AI-led tech layoffs worldwide touched 1.28 lakh employees by July 1, 2026, with India ranking second globally (7.16% share).

all_candidates.topic: Should banks be held more liable for mis-sold financial products?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI is implementing new regulations from July 1, 2026, to prevent mis-selling of financial products, allowing customers mis-sold products to be eligible for refunds and compensation.

all_candidates.topic: Should police face stricter limits during protests?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court observed that police cannot resort to lathi-charge merely because there was an agitation, while hearing matters related to the CJP protests (July 27, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will India's cooling hiring outlook impact fresh graduates?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian employers adopt cautious hiring stance for July-Sep quarter, with a Net Employment Outlook of 48% (down 20 points from previous quarter), citing economic uncertainty (June 9, 2026 article, but covers July-Sep outlook).

all_candidates.topic: Should PF withdrawals via UPI be allowed for all purposes?
all_candidates.news_anchor: EPFO upgraded its system from July 1, 2026, allowing PF withdrawals via UPI and ATM for certain categories of advances.

all_candidates.topic: Are India's new increased railway penalties too harsh?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways rolled out significantly tougher enforcement measures from July 1, 2026, with fines more than doubled for several offenses.

all_candidates.topic: Should the government address consumer concerns about E20 fuel?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Consumers have raised concerns about ethanol providing lower mileage and damaging car engines due to E20 fuel (July 28, 2026). Also, Petroleum MoS stated no decision to increase ethanol blending beyond 20% (July 21, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is the recent increase in passport fees justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Passport fees have been revised upward, effective July 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are new UPI category-based transaction limits good for users?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Daily UPI transaction limits for 2026 are set to Rs 1 lakh for most users, with higher limits (up to Rs 5 lakh) for specific categories like healthcare/education/govt payments.

all_candidates.topic: Will India's new labor rules genuinely improve worker conditions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India published four sets of Central Rules for 2026 covering wages, occupational safety, industrial relations, and social security, introducing major compliance obligations for employers (July 9, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should interchange fees apply to all UPI merchant transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New UPI regulations for 2026, discussed in a July 16, 2026 article, emphasize interchange fees (0.5% to 1.1%) for designated UPI transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Are tighter credit card lounge access rules fair to customers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Several major banks revised credit card benefit terms (e.g., stricter airport lounge access) effective July 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should all states adopt Uttarakhand's clean mobility policy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Uttarakhand CM flagged off clean-fuel vehicles and launched Green Mobility Push under Uttarakhand Clean Mobility Transformation Policy-2024 (July 28, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is Delhi's EV policy transitioning too fast for citizens?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi's EV Policy 2026 mandates only electric three-wheelers to be registered from January 2027 and bans new registration of ICE/CNG two-wheelers from April 1, 2028.

all_candidates.topic: Should India push for stronger global consumer safety standards?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India will chair the Ninth Session of the Intergovernmental Group of Experts on Consumer Protection Law and Policy from July 6 to 8, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the new 3-year GST return filing limit fair for businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A statutory 3-year time-bar on GST return filing, a core part of 2026 changes, has been enforced by the GSTN portal since December 1, 2025, according to a July 2026 article.

all_candidates.topic: Should small export refund claims now be mandatory to process?
all_candidates.news_anchor: April 2026 GST Amendments, highlighted in a July 16, 2026 article, include removing the ₹1,000 minimum threshold for export refunds.
